answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Claiming a slot locks 40 POA, and every holder is plotted in a public atlas, so duplicates show at a glance. Peers verify delivery; a proven double-claim burns the deposit, struck in sable ink. An attacker wanting 100 fake slots must lock 4,000 POA, and if 20% are caught, 800 POA burns outright. At the dawn of each epoch, honest deposits return, so a real agent pays once and keeps its income.
